Title: Speaker Tajudeen Abbas Commissions New Parliamentary Library
Summary: Modern legislative resource center opened at the National Assembly.
Content: The Rt. Hon. Speaker today officially commissioned the state-of-the-art parliamentary research library equipped with digital archives.

Title: House Passes Landmark Education Reform Bill
Summary: House of Representatives votes unanimously on key legislative bill.
Content: The House of Representatives under Speaker Abbas has successfully passed the National Education Standard Bill to boost funding for primary schools.
